_about: Feature films pinned to the top of a team page's multimedia section, newest first. youtube = the video id.

ohio.title: South Bridge
ohio.dek: Our film on Athens, Ohio, its river, its bricks and its Bobcats.

toledo.title: A Hundred Dollars to Fumble
toledo.dek: Our film on Toledo's point-shaving scandal of the mid-2000s, and the betting business that followed it.

akron.title: The Magnet in the Nose
akron.dek: Our film on the 1973 Soap Box Derby scandal in Akron, and who the real cheater was.

fau.title: Owlcatraz (Part I)
fau.dek: Our film on the 2013 fight over a private prison company's name on FAU's stadium. Part one of two.

fiu.title: The Badge on Campus (Part II)
fiu.dek: Our film on FIU campus police joining ICE's 287(g) program and the students who pushed back. Part two of two.

bowling-green.title: The Lightest Banner in Basketball
bowling-green.dek: Our film on Nate Thurmond, the 31 rebounds that are still Bowling Green's record, and the Cleveland banner that weighs the least.
